about: Optional tool groups for agent sessions. install-guards.sh --tools "<groups to keep>" turns every group not kept off in the unit repo's .claude/settings.json and leaves the kept ones on. Never listed here, so never touched: Bash (git, gh), the file tools, the ccd_* session and PR tools, SendMessage, the coordinator plugin, the owner's own MCP servers (for example codebase-memory-mcp), claude-api, code-review.

browser.why: Built-in browser pane, for units that verify UI in a browser.

ios-simulator.why: iOS Simulator, for units that build and check an iOS app.

semi-design.why: Semi Design System skills (semi-ui, semi-check, ...), for UI units.

chrome.why: Claude in Chrome (the owner's real Chrome); agents use the built-in browser instead.

computer-use.why: Desktop control of the owner's Mac; no unit agent needs it.

cloudflare.why: Cloudflare plugin (its MCP server and skills); only a unit that deploys to Cloudflare keeps it.

office.why: Word, PowerPoint, Excel, PDF, Google Workspace and Docs skills; agents write code and Markdown.

artifacts.why: Published pages, inline widgets and charts; agents report by message, not by page.

desktop-extras.why: Terminal panel, scheduled tasks, connector registry and personal-assistant skills; agents use Bash.

connectors.why: claude.ai cloud connectors (Drive, Docs, ...); a unit that reads one keeps it.
